_why: HAND-COMPUTED. The root is a 200x120 column at padding 10, so the single 180x100 box
sits at (10,10). The bitmap is the SETTLED scene after the last retarget landed on C
(0xFF708090): reduced-motion removes travel, not the final colour, so the box interior
is exactly C. (5,5) is the white root surface outside the box.
The behavioural assertions (default animates / mid-flight snap / fresh snap / overlay
entrance+exit honour the switch) are in the program, not here -- they are about TIME,
which a static frame cannot show. The two rects + two points only pin that the probe
mounted the scene it claims to drive.
